$comment: Single source of truth for tinystyle's vocabulary. Generates llms.txt and html-custom-data.json (npm run gen) and drives tinystyle check. A test keeps it in sync with src/*.css.

data-variant.description: Button style. Leave it out for the default solid main button (black in light mode, white in dark mode). Combine with data-tone for color.

values.secondary: Tinted fill, no border. Second most important action.
values.ghost: Transparent, fill on hover. Toolbars, icon buttons, Cancel.
values.link: Looks like a link, keeps button semantics.

data-tone.description: Color role. Independent of data-variant. On text it sets the text color. For a custom color use style="--ts-tone: <color>" instead.

values.neutral: Grey. Default for secondary/outline/ghost buttons and badges.

data-size.description: Control size relative to the current density.

data-icon.description: Square icon-only button. Must have an aria-label. Usually combined with data-variant="ghost".

data-layout.description: Lays out the element's children. Wins over the element's own display, so it also works on label, article, fieldset, dialog. Space between children comes from data-gap, space around them from data-pad; children never get margins.

values.row: Horizontal row that wraps, items vertically centered.
values.grid: Responsive columns, each at least --ts-min wide (default 16rem).
values.split: Sidebar + content. First child is the sidebar (--ts-split, default 16rem); wraps on narrow screens.
values.center: Horizontally centered column with max width --ts-measure (default 72rem) and side padding.

data-gap.description: Space between the children of a data-layout element. Default md. Together with data-pad, the only spacing controls in tinystyle.

data-pad.on: any container: page wrappers, sections, panels, rows
data-pad.description: Padding inside the element, on all sides. Use it instead of padding in style attributes. On data-layout="center" the side padding never drops below md. Overrides a component's own padding (e.g. data-pad="sm" on an article).

data-density.description: Control height and padding for everything inside.

values.compact: 2rem controls, smaller text. For dense apps.

data-theme.description: Forces light or dark mode. Leave it out to follow the operating system.

data-badge.description: Small status label (counts, tags, states). Color with data-tone or style="--ts-tone: …".

data-callout.description: Tinted message box. Put the title in <strong>. Color with data-tone (default info).

data-truncate.description: Single line, cut off with an ellipsis.

data-sr-only.description: Hidden visually, still read by screen readers.

data-pairs.description: Shows dt/dd pairs as a two-column label/value grid.

--ts-hue.description: Accent hue in OKLCH degrees. Default 255.

--ts-neutral-hue.description: Hue the greys lean toward. Default: --ts-hue.

--ts-neutral-tint.description: How much the greys lean toward --ts-neutral-hue. Default 0 (pure grey).

--ts-primary.description: Tone of default buttons. Default var(--ts-neutral); var(--ts-accent) for colored main buttons.

--ts-radius.description: Base corner radius. Default 0.375rem. The other radii derive from it.

--ts-badge-radius.description: Badge corner radius. Default 0.67 × --ts-radius; var(--ts-radius-full) for pills.

--ts-font-sans.description: UI font stack. Default: system fonts.

--ts-min.description: Minimum column width for data-layout="grid". Default 16rem.

--ts-fill.description: Subtle fill: code, hover, neutral secondary buttons.

--ts-accent.description: Accent: selection, focus, links, checked controls.

--ts-neutral.description: Neutral tone (near-black in light mode, near-white in dark mode).

--ts-tone.description: Current tone. Set it to any color to recolor an element and its children (e.g. calendar colors).

--ts-tone-on.description: Text color on a solid --ts-tone fill (black or white).

--ts-shadow-sm.description: Resting shadow (none in the default look).

--ts-control-h.description: Height of buttons and inputs, set by data-density.

--ts-control-px.description: Horizontal padding of controls, set by data-density.

--ts-control-font.description: Font size of controls, set by data-density.
